What is a /now page? A /now page is about what someone is currently focused on and working toward. Think of it like what you’d say to a friend you haven’t seen in a year — a snapshot of what matters most right now.
Unlike social media updates or blog posts, a /now page focuses on the bigger picture rather than day-to-day highlights. It also contrasts with an /about page, which is more static and background-focused. If you want to learn more, check out nownownow.com/about.
So, what’s happening in my life right now? Since finishing my degree in October 2024, I’ve mostly been doing two things: traveling and applying for jobs.
In November and December, I visited friends across Germany and took part in several debating contests. Since January, I’ve been traveling through East Asia (South Korea and Japan) and Oceania (New Zealand and Australia). I’ve also been planning to write some blog posts about my small adventures along the way.
At the same time, I’m trying to revive some routines and sort out boring-but-important life admin — things like insurance, my website, and my portfolio — all while continuing to apply for jobs.
My goal is to land a role in cybersecurity. Worst case? I become a surf teacher in Bali. (I just need to learn how to surf first.)
Last updated: May 2025

Who is this? Take a generous scoop of tech enthusiasm, stir in a love for sports - especially running. Add a good pinch of curiosity for nearly everything. Mix well with lively debates, best served hot. Fold in some nerdy excitement and a splash of dry humor. Let it all simmer over a family background rich in wine. Grain in some CTFs. And there you have it: something that looks suspiciously like me.
I am Moritz, 25 years old and just finished uni. Currently I am travelling through east-asia and figuring out what my first blog post will be about. I studied CS @ Saarland University and I am currently open for work!
Contact and Impressum Responsible for the content of this website is
Moritz Mander
reachable via hier_ist_moritz [at] t-online.de
Of course I also have a GPG Key!
